purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Consumption assertion, resource stock, meter reading, counter delta, allocation, invoice, report and performance decision remain distinct.
WM-FLW-008 parentage remains under review and consumption participates only as a use-side flow assertion.
Resources, consumers, activities, assets, facilities, meters, observations, invoices, ledgers, emissions, impacts, targets and evidence remain external masters.
Energy, water, fuel and material semantics remain profile-discriminated.
Gross and net consumption require explicit boundary and return, recovery, export and loss treatment.
Cost, emissions, footprint, impact, efficiency and compliance cannot be inferred from absolute consumption alone.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The event boundary preserves stable identity, assertion kind, consumer-resource scope, interval, revision and source lineage.
Quantity kind, unit, precision, tolerance, uncertainty, conversion, derivation and allocation are explicit.
Gross input, return, discharge, recovery, reuse, export, loss and net values remain independently typed.
Event, observation, record, invoice, correction and ingestion clocks remain independent.
Competing meter, estimate, allocation, invoice and balance assertions remain visible rather than last-write-wins.
Baseline and target comparison is separated from causal, compliance, billing and environmental-impact decisions.
Protected projections and privileged mutation are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
